description: This file defines types, constants, enums, and structures related to 5G NR RAN (Radio Access Network) configurations, including PDU session IDs, RAN UE IDs, security indications, and support items for network slices and QoS. It also includes formatters for some enums.

classes.name: pdu_session_id_t
classes.description: Enum class representing PDU Session IDs with valid range 0..255 and an invalid value.

classes.name: ran_ue_id_t
classes.description: Enum class representing RAN UE IDs with valid range 0..2^32-1 and an invalid value.

classes.name: slice_support_item_t
classes.description: Structure holding an S-NSSAI object for network slice support.

classes.name: nr_cgi_support_item_t
classes.description: Structure holding an NR cell global ID for support items.

classes.name: ng_ran_qos_support_item_t
classes.description: Structure holding a non-dynamic 5QI descriptor for QoS support.

classes.name: supported_plmns_item_t
classes.description: Structure representing supported PLMN with lists of slices, CGI, and QoS support items.

classes.name: sdap_config_t
classes.description: Structure for SDAP configuration including PDU session, header configs, and QoS flows.

classes.name: security_result_t
classes.description: Structure holding results of security procedures regarding integrity and confidentiality.

classes.name: security_indication_t
classes.description: Structure indicating security protection preferences for integrity and confidentiality.

classes.name: security_result_required
classes.description: Function to determine if a security result should be sent based on security indications.

classes.name: activity_notification_level_t
classes.description: Enum class for activity notification levels (UE, PDU session, DRB).

classes.name: pdu_session_type_t
classes.description: Enum class for PDU session types (IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, Ethernet).

methods.name: pdu_session_id_to_uint
methods.description: Converts a PDU session ID enum to its underlying uint16_t value.

methods.name: uint_to_pdu_session_id
methods.description: Converts a uint16_t to a PDU session ID enum.

methods.name: ran_ue_id_to_uint
methods.description: Converts a RAN UE ID enum to its underlying uint64_t value.

methods.name: uint_to_ran_ue_id
methods.description: Converts an underlying integer to a RAN UE ID enum.

methods.name: from_string
methods.description: Parses a string to set the appropriate security indication enum value.

methods.name: security_result_required
methods.description: Checks if a security result should be sent based on security indication preferences.
